function.name: ThinQ_Connect
function.description: Send a command to control an LG ThinQ appliance, such as an air conditioner, by setting various operation modes and target settings. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

body.description: A dictionary containing the settings and modes to control the LG ThinQ appliance.

airConJobMode.description: The current job mode of the air conditioner.

windStrength.description: The strength of the air flow.

monitoringEnabled.description: Flag to enable or disable air quality monitoring.

airCleanOperationMode.description: The operation mode for air cleaning.

powerSaveEnabled.description: Flag to enable or disable power-saving mode.

coolTargetTemperature.description: The target temperature for cooling in degrees Celsius. Valid values range from 18 to 30.

targetTemperature.description: The general target temperature in degrees Celsius. Valid values range from 18 to 30.

message.content: 어떤 모드를 설정하시겠습니까? 예를 들어, AIR_CLEAN, COOL, 또는 AIR_DRY 중 하나를 선택해 주세요.
message.reasoning:
The user says "모드" which means "mode". They likely want to change the mode of the LG ThinQ appliance. We need to respond with a function call to ThinQ_Connect with appropriate parameters. But we don't know what mode they want. Maybe they want to set the mode? The user just typed "모드" meaning "mode". Possibly they want to ask about the mode. But the instruction says: "When you want to send a command to control an LG ThinQ appliance, use the function." So maybe we should ask clarifying question. But the user only said "모드". That might be ambiguous. According to guidelines, we can ask clarifying question. But the instructions say "If you do not have enough information to answer the user's request, ask clarifying questions." So we should ask them what mode they'd like to set. Or we could interpret "모드" as a request to get the current mode? But there's no function for getting status. Only controlling. So we should ask clarifying question.

Thus we should respond asking: "어떤 모드를 설정하시겠습니까?" (Which mode would you like to set?) Or "현재 모드를 확인하고 싶으신가요?" But we can't get status. So we ask them to specify mode.
